_Do you also feel energized by super smooth Operations and a beautiful CI/CD setup? Do you eat Kubernetes and Azure for breakfast? And do you thrive in a sometimes-unpredictable environment where you jump in and save the day? Then we believe we have something great to offer.

__We are looking for an experienced Azure, Kubernetes, and CI/CD Engineer to help elevate our SaaS operations and internal deployment processes to the next level.

_**Key About Your Role

**We aim to take Operations to the next level by onboarding more skilled human power (you) and using your expertise to refine and modernize our existing Azure setup. The goal is to make it more elegant, clean, and scalable.

As a central figure in the infrastructure everyone depends on, communication and collaboration will be a natural part of your work. You will provide ad hoc support to colleagues and customer representatives, contributing directly to the stability and growth of our platform.

We work with two layers of deployments:

• Platform deployments: Low frequency (around once per month), planned well in advance

• Customer component deployments: Higher frequency (around once per week), shorter planning horizon

Both typically take place outside normal office hours. For these, you will be compensated with time off from your regular schedule. Deployments usually last about 15 minutes, with occasional on-call backup needed for unforeseen issues (fortunately, rare).

Your work will revolve around three main areas as follows:

****Key responsibilities:

• Environments: Refining and improving the setup of our internal and external environments in a beautiful Kubernetes architecture in Azure

• CI/CD: Configuring, maintaining and continuously improving our entire CI/CD universe

• Operations: Participate actively in operations tasks, maintenance windows, deployments, and incident debugging. Together with the small operations team, ensure our platform runs smoothly 24/7

There is a lot more behind the Platform than a simple list of tools can show. Instead of giving you a long inventory, we would rather have an informal conversation where we can explore the details together.

**Key About Your Team

**Our team, named Obex, is a business unit of Keylane, employing around twenty-five awesome developers, business analysts and a few other professions. Our main product is our Obex Platform, a SaaS solution for financial advisory used by advisors in a variety of pension funds and banks.

We are proud that finances of an estimated two million Danes have been through our software. The Obex Platform is developed in close collaboration with our customers, resulting in a product that users truly appreciate.

In Obex we care for each other. Thriving is top priority. You will feel that atmosphere as soon as you enter.

Our organization is flat, the best argument wins, not the highest title. We do things because they make sense. If something stops making sense, we stop doing it, whether that's a process, a line of code, or a piece of architecture. We aim for the best solutions, not for rigid conformity.

We believe in mutual elasticity: We go the extra mile to support you, each other, and our customers. And we expect the same spirit in return. Together, we share responsibility for keeping the Obex machine running smoothly.

There's much more to tell about our way of working, our culture, and our social side (fun activities and parties included), but let's save that for a chat, either online or over a great cup of coffee.

**Questions?

**If you have any further questions regarding this position, please reach out to the hiring manager Rasmus Amossen via mail to rasmus.amossen@keylane.com.

When you have any general questions about Keylane or want to have a quick chat before applying, just reach out to Talent Acquisition Specialist Thomas Thomsen via mail to thomas.thomsen@keylane.com.

**Requirements

****Experience?

**

• You are fluent in Kubernetes, have solid experience with Azure services, virtual network configuration, and Azure DevOps

• You know your way around log and performance monitoring tools and have a passion for clean, well-architected systems

• You are not content with things merely working, you want them to work beautifully

• Our platform uses .NET on the backend, React with Typescript on the frontend, and Aspire for local development orchestration. Experience with these technologies is a plus.

• There is a lot more behind the Platform than a simple list of tools can show. Instead of giving you a long inventory, we would rather have an informal conversation where we can explore the details together

**Using AI

**

• You are interested in using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Codex as part of the software development lifecycle. For example, to explore solutions, understand unfamiliar code, generate or improve code and tests, refactoring, troubleshoot issues, document solutions and support code reviews;

• You understand that AI-generated code and suggestions must be critically evaluated, tested and reviewed. You take ownership of the quality, security, correctness and maintainability of the code you deliver;

**Other

**Please send your application with CV via our website. Applications are evaluated continuously

A criminal record and reference check are part of the application process. Each employee within Keylane must follow training on information security and irrespective to the role basic information security responsibilities apply.

**Benefits

**

• A flat and informal organization with a professional and supportive working environment

• A profit share

• Inclusion days where you decide when to hold your public holidays

• Five weeks of vacation and five Keylane days

• A pension scheme where 13.25% is paid by Keylane and the individual contribution is 3%

• Flexibility in the working environment. We offer a combination of working from home and from the office. We value seeing colleagues in person to stay connected and collaborate effectively

• The Danish office is located a 10-minute walk from Islands Brygge Metro station

• We believe that strong employee relations are key to maintaining well-being in the workplace. To support this, we offer a variety of social activities that all employees can participate in, such as yoga, padel tennis, running, outdoor bathing, and fitness in the basement

• Salary: For this role, the Monthly Base Salary ranges from 43.000 - 56.000 (DKK), corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate's skills, competences, knowledge, and relevant experience

****Job Description:

****Are you ready to drive change, foster a culture of commercial excellence, and lead strategic transformation projects? As the Regional Perfo & Transformation Manager at Satair, you will act as the primary representative for the Commercial Process, Performance & Transformation (ASCX) team in your region. You will bridge the gap between regional teams and the central ASCX pillars of processes, performance, data analytics, and automation to support Satair's commercial objectives. We are looking for a structured, results-oriented leader who can influence without authority and advocate for the region's needs within a complex, shared Airbus ecosystem.

**What The Job Is

**You will report to the Head of Commercial Data Analytics (HO ASCXY) and integrate into a multi-disciplinary team spread across the globe. In this role, you will serve as the regional node for a centralized cross-functional team, meaning you will not have direct reports but will lead by influence across regional commercial teams, account directors, and operations.

Your main responsibilities:

• Regional Commercial Project Portfolio Leadership: Accountable for the regional commercial project portfolio's financial impact and performance metrics, leading transformation projects using LBIP and Agile methodologies.

• Regional AOS Roadmap Execution: Take accountability for the successful implementation of the AOS (Airbus Operating System) regional roadmap in alignment with ASCX and the Regional Managing Director.

• Regional Representation & Connectivity: Act as a critical connector between regional teams and ASCX, representing ASCX in the Regional Customer Satisfaction Review Board (R-CSRB) and other commercial forums.

• Culture & Continuous Improvement: Proactively drive a culture of creativity, commercial excellence, and continuous improvement by identifying and addressing systemic "irritants".

Travel days to be expected are approximately 30% (domestic and international).

**How You Will Contribute To The Team

**We are looking for a proactive professional with an excellent problem-solving mindset and an ability to translate data into actionable insights. You must possess a keen understanding of business issues, key stakeholders, and external dynamics which inform priority setting.

You must hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, or a related field, accompanied by 5-10 years of proven experience leading cross-functional, regional, and global continuous improvement and transformation projects in a complex setting. A strong understanding of aviation aftermarket commercial operations is highly preferred, as are additional certifications in process improvement methodologies (e.g., Six Sigma, Lean). You will thrive in this role if you possess a high degree of agility in learning, exceptional communication and presentation abilities, and a proactive "can-do attitude". Because you will be networking globally, an excellent command of both written and spoken English is required, while proficiency in a secondary language relevant to the assigned region is preferred.

**What does your next challenge look like?

**At SATAIR, we believe in sustainable aviation that allows people to travel and connect across the globe.

We are on a mission to provide world class material solutions that keep aircraft flying and extend their lifespan.

In Satair, you can challenge the status quo, pioneer new ways of working, and generate real value for airlines and suppliers worldwide.

Being part of the Airbus family gives us the opportunity to live a global mindset, working in international and diverse teams and collaborating across functions, sites and cultures.

If you want to work as one team embracing a can-do attitude in a demanding environment, then we offer a great place to explore, learn, and grow, making an impact on aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company!

**About SATAIR

**Satair is an Airbus Services company offering first-class material management solutions in the aviation aftermarket industry. We take pride in delivering an excellent customer experience around the clock, driving innovation, and contributing to aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

With our global functional organisation spanning 12 sites and locations worldwide, and a team of over 2,000 people supporting a $3.9 billion turnover, you will be part of a truly global company that continues to grow year after year.

Welcome to the Satair family!

If you want to know more about our business, have a closer look at our website www.SATAIR.com or check out our SATAIR Youtube Channel at www.youtube.com/sataircompany !

**What do we offer at SATAIR?

**At SATAIR, you will find much more than a job - we offer you the possibility of growing both your personal and professional capacities in a fun, supportive and informal working environment, where you will be encouraged to engage, share knowledge and ideas.

SATAIR is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We love to bring in people with different backgrounds and experiences as we believe it enhances our performance immensely!

Here is a selection of some of the benefits we offer our employees in Copenhagen:

Financial Benefits: Competitive salary, Employee Stock Ownership Program, Success sharing, Health insurance, Group accident insurance, Employee discounts to local businesses

Employee Health and Wellbeing: On-site gym, App-based health & wellbeing platform, Amazing canteen at a subsided price, Massage scheme

Learning and Development: Airbus Leadership University, Large number of e-learning and training offers for personal and professional development, Promotion of professional development (e.g. postgraduate studies, technician training), Possibility of mentoring, Gain international experience

Work-life blend and life phase support: Possibility to work remotely, 4 care days, Senior days, Working from home policy (2 days remote per week)

**Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company

**Please send us your application as soon as possible to get the opportunity to become part of an exceptional global team!

We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

When applying for the position, you accept our data privacy statement: http://www.SATAIR.com/privacy

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.

**The Impact You'll Make

**At Danfoss Sensing Solutions, we develop advanced sensing technologies supporting applications across the Danfoss portfolio. As demand for data centre infrastructure, energy-efficient cooling, and environmental monitoring continues to grow, we are expanding our capabilities to develop the next generation of sensing solutions.

As our Senior Mechanical Engineer, you will strengthen our mechanical engineering expertise within R&D and play an important role in developing future sensing platforms, with a particular focus on gas sensing and data centre applications.

You will help transform new ideas into robust, manufacturable products by driving mechanical architecture and packaging development from early concepts through industrialization. You will also provide technical expertise across mechanical design, packaging, and manufacturability while working closely with colleagues across multiple engineering disciplines.

This is an individual contributor role without people management responsibilities. Instead, your impact will come through technical leadership, influencing engineering decisions, sharing best practices, and strengthening our mechanical engineering capabilities.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**You will lead mechanical development activities across innovation and new product development projects, ensuring solutions are technically robust, scalable, and aligned with customer needs.

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Leading the mechanical architecture and design of next-generation sensing platforms, including housings, packaging, mounting concepts, and system integration.

• Developing robust encapsulation, sealing, and environmental protection solutions for sensors operating under demanding industrial conditions

• Driving mechanical work packages in innovation and product development projects in close collaboration with sensing specialists, electronics, firmware, manufacturing engineers, product management, and external partners.

• Developing mechanical concepts for gas sensing and data centre applications, including thermal management, fluid interfaces, installation concepts, and system-level solutions.

• Supporting prototyping, design reviews, risk assessments, testing activities, and supplier collaboration to enable successful industrialization.

**What We're Looking For

**You have a strong foundation in mechanical engineering combined with hands-on product development experience. You are comfortable taking ownership of complex mechanical challenges while collaborating across engineering disciplines.

To be successful in this role, we are looking for:

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline.

• Extensive experience developing industrial products from concept through production, including complex mechanical design challenges.

• Hands-on experience with mechanical design of sensors, electronic products, or other highly integrated mechanical systems.

• Strong experience with 3D CAD tools such as Inventor.

• Experience with injection-moulded components and Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) principles.

**It Would Be An Advantage If You Also Have

**

• Experience with sensor technology and sensor packaging.

• Knowledge within areas such as sealing and joining technologies, thermal management, tolerance analysis, rapid prototyping, or high-volume manufacturing.

We recognize that great candidates may bring different combinations of experience and expertise. If you believe your background can contribute to developing our next generation of sensing solutions, we encourage you to apply.

**What You'll Get From Us

**You will join a highly skilled R&D environment working on technologies that contribute to safer, more energy-efficient, and more sustainable solutions across a broad range of applications.

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

jobs.description:
atNorth is the leading Nordic data center company specializing in scalable high-density colocation and built-to-suit facilities that meet the unique needs of today’s AI and high performance workloads. With more than 15 years of proven expertise, atNorth delivers secure, flexible and sustainable infrastructure, powered entirely by renewable energy and benefitting from advanced cooling technologies, including several Direct Liquid Cooling and Direct to Chip installations. By combining operational excellence and a commitment to environmental responsibility with trusted customer relationships that enable rapid scalability, atNorth empowers businesses to grow while minimizing their environmental impact. Headquartered in Reykjavik, Iceland, atNorth operates eight data centers across strategic Nordic locations, with a site to open in Ballerup, Denmark in 2025, as well as its tenth under construction in Kouvola, Finland and its eleventh site in Varde Municipality, Denmark. The business has also secured land for a future mega site in the Sollefteå Municipality in Sweden. For more information, visit atNorth.com or follow atNorth on LinkedIn.

Are you a senior leader passionate about creating exceptional customer experiences and translating customer needs into meaningful product and service improvements? Do you have the strategic mindset and leadership skills to connect customer insight, commercial priorities and operational realities?

atNorth is looking for a Senior Manager of Customer Experience & Product to lead the Customer Experience & Product function within Customer Operations. In this role, you will shape the customer experience strategy, drive customer journey excellence and oversee product, service catalogue and customer-facing platform priorities across an international and fast-growing digital infrastructure organization.

The Role

As Senior Manager of Customer Experience & Product, you will own the frameworks, standards and priorities that ensure a clear, scalable and consistent customer experience across atNorth. You will translate customer insight, business objectives and operational needs into clear priorities, OKRs and roadmaps.

The role combines customer experience strategy, product and service management, digital platform development and leadership. You will work closely with Product, IT, Sales, Client Management, Implementation, Operations, Service Delivery and Performance & Governance to ensure that customer needs are reflected in how atNorth develops its services, processes and digital capabilities.

Key responsibilities include:

• Define and lead the Customer Experience & Product strategy, operating framework, standards and governance routines.

• Translate business objectives, customer insight and operational needs into priorities, OKRs and roadmaps.

• Own the end-to-end customer journey framework and standards for customer interactions throughout the customer lifecycle.

• Govern customer feedback and satisfaction insights, ensuring that customer insight is translated into tangible improvements.

• Set standards for customer onboarding, communication, enablement, knowledge and self-service experiences.

• Own Customer Operations governance of the service catalogue, customer-facing service definitions and product/service lifecycle input.

• Define and prioritize customer-facing requirements for the portal, CRM, Jira and other digital and self-service capabilities.

• Ensure customer needs, commercial priorities and operational realities are reflected in product, service and platform roadmaps.

• Lead and develop the Product Manager and Customer Experience Manager, setting direction, priorities, performance expectations and development goals

• Represent customer experience and product priorities in management, governance and roadmap forums.

• Drive cross-functional priorities by aligning stakeholders across Product, IT, Sales, Client Management, Implementation, Operations, Service Delivery and Performance & Governance.

• Monitor progress against Customer Experience & Product OKRs, strategic priorities and improvement roadmaps, identifying risks and driving timely decisions.

You will also have the authority to set functional priorities, allocate work across Product Management and Customer Experience, and prioritize customer-facing product, service, process and platform improvements within agreed strategy, budget and governance boundaries.

atNorth is an international and fast-growing company where collaboration, ownership and continuous improvement are central to the culture. In this role, you will have broad cross-functional exposure and the opportunity to shape how customers experience atNorth – from onboarding and communication to services, products and digital platforms.

Is this you?

We are looking for an experienced and commercially minded leader who combines a strong customer focus with strategic thinking, product understanding and the ability to turn insight into action. You are comfortable navigating complex organizations and bringing different stakeholders together around a common customer and business agenda.

You have:

• 8–10+ years of experience within customer experience, customer success, product or service management, service delivery or related fields.

• Experience from data center, IT infrastructure, B2B technology or another complex service environment.

• Proven leadership experience and the ability to develop and empower high-performing teams.

• Strong understanding of customer experience strategy, customer journeys and service design.

• Experience with product and service portfolio management and/or service catalogue governance.

• The ability to translate customer, commercial and operational insight into clear priorities and measurable outcomes.

• Experience managing customer-facing digital platforms, requirements or self-service capabilities.

• Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.

• Excellent communication, facilitation and executive-level reporting skills.

• A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Product Management, Service Management, IT, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

• Fluency in English; proficiency in Danish is preferred.

As a person, you are strategic, customer-focused and decisive, with a strong ability to create clarity in complex environments. You are a natural collaborator who can build relationships across functions while confidently challenging existing ways of working when needed. You combine commercial awareness with an analytical and pragmatic approach and are motivated by creating measurable improvements in both customer experience and business performance.

Experience or certification in ITIL, product management, service design or customer experience is considered an advantage.

**QA Manufacturing Support Technician

****Be close to production and make a difference in quality every day

**At AGC Biologics in Søborg, Quality and Manufacturing go hand in hand. As our new QA Manufacturing Support Technician, you will play an important role in supporting manufacturing activities during solution preparation and ensuring that production documentation meets GMP requirements.

This position offers an exciting combination of working close to the production line and handling batch record reviews and buffer and media documentation. You will be an important link between QA and Manufacturing, helping to connect the two functions and support a smooth and compliant manufacturing process.

**Where Quality meets Manufacturing

**In this role, you will support the Manufacturing Batch Release process by ensuring that solution (media and buffers) batch documentation are reviewed in accordance with established procedures and GMP requirements.

**Your Daily Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Performing QA Oversight in the Solution Preparation production suite in VAT83B.

• Supporting manufacturing during review of batch documentation, including questions related to Good Documentation Practice.

• Reviewing and approving Buffer and Media Batch Production Records.

• Printing Batch Process Records and managing manufacturing labels.

• Providing real-time review of manufacturing records and logbooks.

You may also support scanning, archiving and other related activities when needed.

What makes this position particularly interesting is the opportunity to combine documentation review with direct interaction with production. You will be close to daily manufacturing activities while contributing to the Quality processes that support batch release.

**A dynamic team with strong connections to production

**You will become part of a dynamic and proactive QA team consisting of 7 Scientists and 4 Student Assistants.

The team works closely with Manufacturing, and collaboration is an important part of everyday work. Together with your manager and colleagues, you will help build strong connections between QA and Manufacturing, acting as a bridge between the teams.

This is a role for someone who enjoys being involved in daily operations, working with different colleagues and combining structured documentation tasks with close collaboration on the production floor.

**Bring your attention to detail and collaborative mindset

**We imagine that you hold a Bachelor's degree (BSc) or a qualification as a Technician in production. Ideally, you have experience from a GMP or GLP production environment or a QA department within the biopharmaceutical industry.

You bring an interest in, or previous experience with, reviewing Batch Production Records and Solution Preparation Sheets.

Strong communication and collaboration skills are important, as you will work with colleagues and stakeholders across functions. You are fluent in written and spoken English and communicate clearly with both internal and external stakeholders.

As a person, you have a positive mindset, are flexible and enjoy taking on new tasks and responsibilities. You thrive in a dynamic environment and are comfortable navigating uncertainties.

**Interested in joining our team?

**We will review applications as they arrive, so please submit your application and CV as soon as possible.

We look forward to hearing from you.

**Who We Are

**AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.

Ready to lead software deployment, training and technical support projects for Defence customers, develop your team and shape a growing department? Combine hands-on project delivery with direct people management, bringing mission-critical software to military customers across the Nordics.

**The job

**As Project & People Manager in our Nordic Constellation, you will manage and lead multiple customer projects simultaneously. These projects involve deploying our SitaWare and Iris product suites into customers’ organisations, delivering training services, providing technical support for military exercises and helping customers get the most from our products.

Alongside responsibility for the delivery and implementation of our Defence product suites at our customers, you will:

• Ensure delivery to the agreed scope, schedule and quality standards while maintaining and developing long-term customer relationships.

• Work closely with our business development team to expand customer engagement in new and established markets by shaping and scoping solutions, preparing estimates and writing commercial proposals.

• Take direct people and line management responsibility, including recruitment, employee development and retention.

• Together with your team, foster an engaging workplace where people enjoy coming to work.

You will on a regular basis travel to customer locations in the Nordic countries, most predominantly in the Capitol Region in Denmark.

**Joining the team

**Join Defence Services, Nordic, and help customers in Denmark and across Scandinavia bring our SitaWare solutions into their organisations. In Copenhagen, you will join a Defence Services team of around 10 people, including fellow managers, solution architects, solution engineers and student workers. As our department grows, you will have the opportunity to help shape how we work and strengthen our leadership team. Reporting to the Senior Director for the Nordic Constellation, you will collaborate with fellow managers and colleagues across constellations, combining hands-on project delivery with people management.

**You bring solid experience leading software or IT projects using agile methods and enjoy combining project delivery with managing and developing employees. You take ownership and are ready to grow your responsibilities as you deliver results.

We are also looking for:

• A relevant degree in IT, software or a related field, preferably at master’s level.

• Direct line management experience with formal responsibility for employees, including coaching, motivation and development, along with the ability to influence people both within and outside the organisation.

• Experience working directly with customers and other stakeholders - experience in defence or a similar industry is a clear advantage.

• Fluency in spoken and written English.

• Project management certification, such as PMI, PRINCE2 or IPMA Level B/C, and Scrum or ITIL certification backed by practical experience - these are an advantage, but not a requirement.

• A decisive, results-driven mindset combined with an analytical, structured approach, and the ability to engage customers, end-users, senior management and your team to deliver projects within budget, on schedule and to the required quality standards.

• A collaborative colleague who contributes to both achieving results and fostering a positive team culture.

If so, you may be our new Quality Team Leader at NORMAL’s warehouse in Hedensted.

**As Quality Team Leader, you will lead and support the Quality Team across both day and evening shifts. Your leadership skills, ability to motivate others, and focus on continuous improvement will be key to your success.

You will set a clear direction for the team, develop employees, improve processes, and ensure smooth communication between shifts and departments. You will also work closely with colleagues and stakeholders across the organization to maintain and improve the quality standards delivered to our stores and warehouse.

Experience from logistics or warehousing is an advantage, but it is not essential. What matters most is your ability to lead, communicate clearly, and bring out the best in people.

At NORMAL, we believe in trust, open communication, and teamwork. In this role, you will help create a positive and supportive workplace where people feel valued, take ownership, and are encouraged to do their best every day.

**Your Responsibilities

**

• Lead, support, and develop the Quality Team.

• Motivate and develop employees through clear communication, coaching, feedback, and encouragement.

• Plan daily operations and coordinate staffing and schedules.

• Recruiting the right talent and build a strong team.

• Identify opportunities for improvement and implement practical, effective solutions.

• Ensure a smooth transition and strong communication between day and evening shift.

• Maintain an ongoing dialogue with internal and external stakeholders about quality standards we deliver to our stores and improvement opportunities.

You remain calm and focused when things get busy, communicate clearly, and know how to keep people engaged. You bring a proactive, positive, and people-focused attitude to your work – and you genuinely care about your team and the results you achieve together.

**

• Communicate confidently in English, both verbally and in writing.

• Are flexible and able to support the team across both day and evening shifts.

• Are comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and coordinating with multiple stakeholders.

**It Is An Advantage If You

**

• Have experience working with a Warehouse Management System or similar tools.

• Have experience working with ERP-systems.

• Are familiar with SQL or other database structures.

**Why join NORMAL A/S?

****At NORMAL, You Will Get

**

• The opportunity to make a real impact on our growing operations.

• A down-to-earth workplace where people work together and ideas are heard.

• A role with responsibility, variety, and influence.

• Opportunities to develop your skills and grow your career.

• The chance to lead a committed team and help create a positive working environment.

If you enjoy leading by example, creating positive energy, and achieving great results through people, we would love to hear from you.

**Location and working hours

**

• Employment: Full-time, 37 hours per week

**Kirsten Marie Ravn

kira@normal.dk

Are you passionate about bioanalytical operational aspects of clinical trials? Do you have experience within clinical trial planning, timelines, and working with special labs?

Opportunity

At Maersk Air Cargo, we’re proud to play an important role in Maersk’s ambition to deliver truly integrated global logistics. Our aviation operation brings together specialist expertise, teamwork and a strong commitment to safe and reliable operations. We are now looking for a CAMO Base Maintenance Planner & Technical Representative to join our team and contribute to the continued development and success of our air cargo operation.

**About the role

**This is a hands-on role combining detailed base maintenance planning with the opportunity to represent CAMO on site during scheduled maintenance inputs. You will take ownership of assigned base maintenance events, including C-Checks, coordinating the work scope, materials and technical requirements before acting as the key CAMO interface with the contracted Part-145 maintenance organisation during the maintenance input. It’s an opportunity to work across the complete base-maintenance lifecycle rather than focusing purely on planning.

Flexibility to travel extensively is essential, with approximately 40–60 travel days per year, typically in periods of 2–5 weeks at a time, depending on the base maintenance schedule. Travel requirements may increase as the fleet grows. This role would particularly suit an experienced aircraft maintenance technician looking to transition from a hands-on, shift-based environment into a CAMO/office-based position, while remaining closely connected to aircraft maintenance activities.

What you’ll be doing

**Base maintenance planning & preparation

**You will:

• Plan and prepare assigned base maintenance inputs and the associated work package.

• Ensure scheduled tasks, ADs, EOs, inspections, modifications and other approved requirements are included.

• Coordinate material, component, rotable and modification-kit availability with Logistics.

• Align technical scope, schedule and readiness with Engineering, MCC, Technical Records and the selected MRO.

• Support task-card, maintenance-programme and planning-system improvements, including lessons learned.

Technical representation & on-site coordination

During assigned maintenance inputs, you will

• Act as the on-site CAMO Technical Representative and primary interface with the MRO during assigned checks.

• Monitor progress, findings, quality indicators, man-hour development, material status and schedule risks; report status to CAMO.

• Coordinate technical queries, additional work and findings; approve only within delegated authority and escalate when required.

• Monitor that the agreed maintenance scope is completed and appropriately documented by the contracted Part-145 organisation.

• Coordinate return-to-operation readiness with iOCC and relevant stakeholders, including deferred-item disposition where applicable.

• Ensure maintenance records, release documentation and system updates are received, reviewed, filed and followed through to closure.

**What we’re looking for

**Ideally, you will have:

• A minimum of three years’ relevant continuing-airworthiness knowledge and practical experience.

• Good working knowledge of EASA Part-CAMO and Part-145, with knowledge of Part-21.

• Understanding of MSG-3 principles, Aircraft Maintenance Programmes and scheduled maintenance planning.

• Experience working with aircraft technical manuals such as AMM, IPC, SRM, SSM, FIM, WDM and MEL, as applicable.

• Good understanding of work packages, task cards, maintenance records, ADs, EOs, modifications and repairs.

• Relevant aircraft-type general familiarisation and applicable company procedures, including CTS-1 and CTS-2.

• Strong communication, coordination and stakeholder-management skills in English.

• The ability to work independently and make sound decisions within delegated authority.

• Flexibility to travel for extended periods during assigned maintenance inputs.

• Experience or an AML relating to Boeing 767 or Boeing 777 aircraft would be advantageous.

Actona Group operates in a dynamic and fast-changing commercial environment, where access to relevant data and the ability to translate it into actionable insights are increasingly important for commercial decision-making. As part of the Pricing & Commercial Excellence team, you will take on a central role in strengthening the commercial organisation through pricing, analytics, performance management and the continued development of commercial tools and processes.

The position combines a strong analytical and hands-on focus with the opportunity to contribute to the broader development of Commercial Excellence across Actona Group.

In this role, you will work at the intersection of data, pricing and commercial decision-making. A key responsibility will be to understand Actona’s pricing model in depth, take ownership of the technical solution behind it and ensure that management decisions related to pricing are effectively implemented. Alongside this, you will identify, collect and analyse relevant commercial data and turn your findings into concrete recommendations and initiatives. You will work with both structured and unstructured data, which calls for an investigative mindset and the ability to find relevant information even when it is not readily available.

At the same time, you will contribute to Actona’s broader Commercial Excellence agenda by developing and evaluating tactical commercial initiatives, supporting performance management and continuously improving the tools and processes that strengthen commercial execution.

Key responsibilities include:

• 
Maintain and further develop Actona’s pricing model and technical pricing solution

• 
Develop analyses, scenarios and decision-support tools to support commercial and pricing decisions

• 
Analyse price and margin development and identify commercial opportunities, risks and areas requiring action

• 
Translate commercial data and insights into concrete initiatives and recommendations

• 
Develop and analyse tactical commercial campaigns and follow up on their commercial impact

• 
Support commercial performance management by identifying opportunities, gaps and areas of underperformance

• 
Prepare clear and decision-oriented material for commercial management and relevant stakeholders

• 
Continuously develop analytical tools, methods and Commercial Excellence processes

• 
Explore how AI and other digital solutions can support commercial analyses, processes and decision-making

• 
Contribute to the implementation of a new CRM system, helping shape commercial processes and strengthen the use of data and insights across the organisation

Success in the role means that you are able to turn complex commercial information into analyses and recommendations that create value for the sales organisation. You drive and coordinate commercial initiatives across the organisation and locations, help sales directors focus and prioritise through relevant analyses, and ensure that pricing decisions are translated accurately and efficiently into the pricing model and commercial execution.

You have experience from areas such as pricing, Commercial Excellence, business analytics, BI, strategy, consulting or finance. You are comfortable working hands-on with data and commercial analysis and, importantly, know how to turn complex information into clear, actionable insights for commercial organisation.

You hold a relevant Master’s degree within engineering, mathematics, economics, business, finance or a similar field. You are highly proficient in Excel and experienced with Power BI or comparable BI tools, and you are comfortable working with complex datasets and developing analytical solutions. An interest in AI and emerging digital tools is an advantage. You are fluent in Danish and English, both written and spoken, and you communicate insights clearly to different audiences.

You are curious, commercially minded and able to create structure in a dynamic environment. You collaborate effectively across stakeholders, communicate clearly and maintain progress as priorities shift.

Actona’s culture is defined by three core values: Acceleration, Customer-Centricity and Trust. They believe in responsibility, collaboration and continuous improvement – and offer a work environment where people are encouraged to challenge, learn, and grow. You will get to work closely with decision-makers, contribute to strategic initiatives, and help shape how data is used across a global organisation.

Location: Holstebro

Travel: Up to 15 days per year

Take the next step in your career
